summary.en: The tally sound: the data bed (F lydian, 104–120 BPM), landings that walk up the scale, roulette ticks and a stamp, a chime on the accent.
summary.zh: tally 的声音：data 音乐床（F 利底亚，104–120 BPM），落点音高沿音阶上行，轮盘嘀嗒加盖章，强调色配一声钟。

fits: Counting and data stories; any film made of many small landings.
notFor: Launch films that need a drop; voice-over films (duck it instead).

intent.en: Many small landings become a phrase: pitches walk up the scale, so counting sounds like progress.
intent.zh: 许多小落点连成一句：音高沿音阶上行，计数听起来像前进。

content.en: A film on the arc of its style; event kinds from the scenes' plans.
content.zh: 按其风格骨架编排的片子；事件种类来自各场景的 plan。

fits.zh: 计数与数据故事；由许多小落点组成的片子。

notFor.zh: 需要高潮段的发布片；有旁白的片（改为压低）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; its presets and cues are read off the template's score.mjs (card, Differs from upstream)
